LESSON: CLASSICAL MUSIC (MEDIEVAL AND RENAISSANCE)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: MUSIC AND DANCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Critical Appreciation
Topic 3.2: Classical Music (Medieval and Renaissance)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Classical Music (Medieval and Renaissance), part of Critical Appreciation in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How does exposure to genres of music from the prescribed period influence an individual’s response to music?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. in pairs or purposive groups, listen to and discuss the characteristics of music genres in the prescribed periods. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication (Apply this adaptation in the subsequent learning experiences involving speech),

2. in pairs or purposive groups, discuss the influences of the characteristic of the period on the features of the music,

3. responsibly search for, listen to and aurally identify the prescribed 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. in pairs or purposive groups, listen to and discuss the characteristics of music genres in the prescribed periods. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication (Apply this adaptation in the subsequent learning experiences involving speech),
2. in pairs or purposive groups, discuss the influences of the characteristic of the period on the features of the music,
3. responsibly search for, listen to and aurally identify the prescribed 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Classical Music (Medieval and Renaissance) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner listens critically and speaks/ mimes/ signs clearly or writes/types on

themes, messages and characteristics of music genres in the prescribed periods of music.

63

• Citizenship: The learner appreciates music from different global cultures.

• Digital Literacy: The learner searches for and listens to genres of music from the prescribed periods from online

sources.

64

Values:
• Unity: The learner collaborates with others as they listen to genres of music from different periods.

• Responsibility: The learner makes appropriate use of digital devices when accessing music from the internet

• Respect: The learner recognizes the input of every member of the class as they participate in group activities on genres

of music.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

• Online safety: The learner responsibly uses digital devices to search for genres of music to listen to.

• Self-esteem: The learner gains confidence as they perform music before an audience.

Suggested Learning Resources

Song books, ICT devices, Internet connectivity, Exercise books, Sheet music, Resource persons, Audio/visual recordings

of prescribed music genres of the periods, Portfolios, Textbooks, Exercise books, Sheet music, Anecdotal records
